name: pnp-copilot-pro-dev-da-workplace-concierge
title: Workplace Concierge - desk & room booking with MCP Apps widgets
shortDescription: A declarative agent whose MCP server renders interactive seat-map and bookings widgets inline in Microsoft 365 Copilot chat.
longDescription: Workplace Concierge is a declarative agent for Microsoft 365 Copilot that helps employees find and book desks and meeting rooms, see who is in the office, and manage their bookings. Its action is a TypeScript MCP server that serves MCP Apps interactive UI widgets: Copilot renders a clickable office seat map and a bookings list inline in the chat. Users book a desk by selecting it on the map; the widgets call MCP tools directly from the UI and hand control back to the agent with follow-up messages. The sample demonstrates registering widget resources with the text/html+skybridge MIME type, linking tools to widgets with the openai/outputTemplate metadata field, returning structuredContent for widgets to render, and using the window.openai host bridge with feature detection, theming, and full-screen support.
